tweet.text:
A little bit chaotic but I kind of like it. 

PromptShare GPT 2.6: 2x2 grid, 16:9, do research, do this for 4 news that keeps people up at night: INPUT = [SUBJECT]

V = {
  SCENARIO   : infer relatable chaos, obsession or contradiction,
  CHARACTER  : auto | human | animal | object | mascot | personification,
  EXPRESSION : deadpan | exhausted | manic | annoyed | overwhelmed,
  ACTIVITY   : subject-derived absurd action,
  PROPS      : 2–4 surreal subject-specific objects,
  SIDEKICK   : auto | comedic creature | animated object | none,
  DOODLES    : 12–30 tiny thematic icons,
  PALETTE    : black / white / orange / teal / coral / yellow,
  CONTRAST   : flat webtoon × scratchy ink chaos,
  FORMAT     : auto | portrait | square | landscape
}

C₁  SUBJECT DNA + COMEDIC SCENARIO (master)
    infer SUBJECT identity, personality, frustrations, habits, recognizable objects and visual contradictions; invent one absurd, relatable situation where the subject's internal state clashes humorously with its surroundings.
    ¬C₁ = generic office burnout / automatic coffee obsession / unrelated visual jokes.

C₂  CLEAN WEBTOON HERO
    embody SUBJECT as [CHARACTER], adapting anatomy, outfit, symbols and [EXPRESSION] to its identity; use simplified anime/webtoon proportions, smooth black contours, flat color blocks and minimal shading. Keep the hero visually calm despite the chaos.
    ¬C₂ = fixed glasses/sweater character / realistic anatomy / scratchy hero rendering / generic mascot.

C₃  DENSE SEMANTIC DOODLE WALL
    cover the entire background with [DOODLES] derived from SUBJECT: tiny icons, symbolic objects, handwritten fragments, expressive squiggles and recurring motifs. Flat collage density, playful irregularity, limited [PALETTE], almost no empty background.
    ¬C₃ = generic office icons / empty walls / photorealistic scenery / unrelated doodles.

C₄  SCRATCHY SURREAL MIDGROUND
    construct [PROPS] as exaggerated metaphors for SUBJECT's behavior, stress, ambition or absurdity; render with aggressive stippling, jittery crosshatching, scratchy contours and noisy ink textures. Everyday objects may mutate into impossible functional hybrids.
    ¬C₄ = ordinary furniture / realistic props / polished vector surfaces / random surrealism.

C₅  COMEDIC SIDEKICK + PHYSICAL GAG
    introduce [SIDEKICK] only when it strengthens the narrative; make it perform [ACTIVITY] with exaggerated emotion, physically interacting with the surreal props. Choose species/form from SUBJECT rather than defaulting to cats.
    ¬C₅ = obligatory orange cat / disconnected mascot / competing protagonists / meaningless action.

C₆  THREE-LAYER COLLISION
    BACK → dense flat thematic doodle wallpaper;
    MID → noisy, scratch-ink surreal props + optional sidekick;
    FRONT → clean flat-color webtoon hero, dominant and sharply readable.
    Maintain deliberate visual separation through scale, overlap, contour density and contrasting texture.
    ¬C₆ = uniform rendering / merged layers / noisy protagonist / weak depth hierarchy.

C₇  COLOR + TEXTURE DISSONANCE
    distribute [PALETTE] across dense background micro-icons and surreal midground; reserve one strong subject-derived color for the foreground hero. Crisp smooth fills clash against coarse ink scratches, with black contours unifying the image.
    ¬C₇ = muddy colors / full-scene texture / soft painterly shading / inconsistent outlines.

C₈  ADAPTIVE CHAOS COMPOSITION
    select [FORMAT] from SUBJECT and [SCENARIO]; place the clean hero at the strongest focal point, frame with surreal midground activity and edge-to-edge doodle density. The overall scene feels overstimulating while its central character remains instantly readable.
    ¬C₈ = fixed treadmill/laptop composition / cluttered focal point / empty background / cropped narrative props.

η   CONTROLLED OVERSTIMULATION
    sharp webtoon hero × frantic scratch-ink surrealism × densely packed colorful doodle wallpaper; strong layer contrast, subject-specific visual jokes, exaggerated emotional tension, cohesive black outlines, deliberately jarring mixed-media finish.

FORBIDDEN = default creator character · automatic coffee/cats · generic office props · identical layer textures · photorealism · empty wallpaper · unrelated doodles · chaotic focal hierarchy · excessive gradients · weak comedic contrast
